question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bag and baggage
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'With all belongings'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** "Bag and baggage"** means to take all of one's belongings, whether they are necessary or not. So, the **correct option** is:* With all belongings.*
